title: SISO Skills evidence-backed repository boundary map

license.reason: The SISO-owned Hub and bundled skill source carry MIT; promoted external source retains its independently declared rights.

evidence.summary: MIT license text is present at the pinned release.

addressable.reason: The public Skills Hub is pinned to an exact commit.

evidence.summary: The canonical public commit resolves and matches remote main.

archive_downloadable.reason: A commit-scoped public source archive is recorded.

evidence.summary: The archive locator is immutable by commit pin.

manifest_resolvable.reason: The release resolves to the permanent Skills Work and its exact source artifact.

evidence.summary: Registry, promotion assessments, generated HTML, and source revision agree.

installable.reason: A bundled atomic Skill materializes into a disposable install root without nested Git or runtime state.

evidence.summary: All 28 entries validated and GitHub Search installed in disposable state.

forkable.reason: The whole Hub is public and forkable; individual repositories are created only after the published promotion gate passes.

evidence.summary: Fork sizes, immutable source receipts, and the no-submodule promotion contract are documented.

portable.reason: Registry, installation, and promotion contracts are portable, but the direct-source assessment identifies stale environment recipes and system adapters that are not yet portable capabilities.

evidence.summary: All 28 entries are machine-classified with explicit remediation blockers rather than receiving a blanket portability claim.

All 28 skill definitions were read and mapped: 10 move to Playbooks, 3 reconcile with Agent Brain, 10 retire or replace, 4 stay bundled, 1 becomes a candidate only after evidence, and 0 promote immediately.
Committed session state was removed; the gate now rejects runtime database/state files and verifies environment-backed local state in a disposable root.
